title: Easy Lives Plugin
description: Simple way to manage lives with recipes for extra lives, revives, and recipes without ever leaving the game!
body:
Minecraft Lives Plugin
A comprehensive lives system plugin for Minecraft Paper servers that enhances gameplay with player lives management.

Key Features
Lives System: Tracks player lives with configurable limits
Admin Controls: Commands and GUI for server administrators
Revival Mechanics: Custom revival beacons to restore lives
Death Management: Configurable penalties on player death
Player Bans: Automatic bans when players run out of lives
Custom Recipes: Craftable items for the lives system

Commands
/lives - Check or manage lives
/revivetool - Get a revival beacon (admin)
/livesadmin - Open admin GUI

Technical Details
Built for PaperMC 1.21
Persistent data storage
Custom events and listeners
Permission-based access control

This plugin is ideal for hardcore-style gameplay or servers looking to add an extra layer of challenge with lives management.
